description: `trigger.pause` is the OPERATIONAL off (TR12): 'not right now', someone's to undo this afternoon — distinct from TriggerAccess, the governance rule with an author and a lifetime. It answers Found/Reason as facts in the result, not transport errors: an unknown id gets one sentence that leaks nothing. It is NOT on the narrow surface (R6: operational control there hands a caller the means to bypass the guards written to constrain it).

result.reason: paused — the clock will skip this trigger until it is resumed (TR12's operational off; governance said nothing)
